subject: Higher Mathematics
question: \[ (A + Bx)^n \] is an algebraic expression and \[ f(x) = \ln \frac{7 - x}{7 + x} \]
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"If \[ p^a = q^b = r^c \] and \[ q^2 = pr \], then show that, \[ a^{-1} + c^{-1} = 2b^{-1} \].","marks":0,"answer":"Given, \[ p^a = q^b \] ∴ \[ p = q^{b/a} \]
Again, \[ r^c = q^b \] ∴ \[ r = q^{b/c} \]
Now, \[ pr = q^2 \] ⇒ \[ q^{b/a} \cdot q^{b/c} = q^2 \] ⇒ \[ q^{b/a + b/c} = q^2 \]
⇒ \[ \frac{b}{a} + \frac{b}{c} = 2 \] ⇒ \[ b \left( \frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{c} \right) = 2 \] ⇒ \[ \frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{c} = \frac{2}{b} \]
∴ \[ a^{-1} + c^{-1} = 2b^{-1} \] (Showed)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If \[ A = 3 \] and \[ B = 1 \], then which values of n for the co-efficient of \[ 5^{th} \] and \[ 6^{th} \] terms of the expansion are same?","marks":0,"answer":"Expression becomes \[ (3 + x)^n \]
In expansion of \[ (3 + x)^n \], \[ (r+1)^{th} \] term coefficient = \[ ^n C_r 3^{n-r} \]
Coefficient of \[ 5^{th} \] term = \[ ^n C_4 3^{n-4} \]
Coefficient of \[ 6^{th} \] term = \[ ^n C_5 3^{n-5} \]
According to condition:
\[ ^n C_4 3^{n-4} = ^n C_5 3^{n-5} \]
\[ \frac{n!}{4!(n-4)!} \cdot \frac{3^n}{3^4} = \frac{n!}{5!(n-5)!} \cdot \frac{3^n}{3^5} \]
\[ \frac{1}{(n-4)} = \frac{1}{5 \cdot 3} \]
\[ n-4 = 15 \]
\[ n = 19 \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Determine \[ f(x) \] function’s domain and range.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ f(x) = \ln \frac{7 - x}{7 + x} \]
For logarithm to be defined, \[ \frac{7-x}{7+x} > 0 \]
Case (i): \[ 7+x > 0 \] and \[ 7-x > 0 \] ⇒ \[ x > -7 \] and \[ x < 7 \] ⇒ Domain = \[ (-7, 7) \]
Case (ii): \[ 7+x < 0 \] and \[ 7-x < 0 \] ⇒ \[ x < -7 \] and \[ x > 7 \] ⇒ No solution.
∴ Domain \[ D_f = (-7, 7) \]
Let \[ y = \ln \frac{7-x}{7+x} \] ⇒ \[ e^y = \frac{7-x}{7+x} \]
⇒ \[ 7 - x = 7e^y + x e^y \] ⇒ \[ x(e^y + 1) = 7(1 - e^y) \] ⇒ \[ x = \frac{7(1 - e^y)}{1 + e^y} \]
For all real y, x is real. ∴ Range = \[ \mathbb{R} \] (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question:
(i) \[ A = \left( y^2 + \frac{P}{y^2} \right)^6 \]
(ii) \[ f(x) = \ln \frac{7 + x}{7 - x} \]
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"If \[ 8^{2x} = 2^{x+1} \], then find the value of x.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ 8^{2x} = 2^{x+1} \] ⇒ \[ (2^3)^{2x} = 2^{x+1} \] ⇒ \[ 2^{6x} = 2^{x+1} \]
⇒ \[ 6x = x + 1 \] ⇒ \[ 5x = 1 \] ⇒ \[ x = \frac{1}{5} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"In the expansion of A, the value of y free term is 14580, then find the value of P.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ A = \left( y^2 + \frac{P}{y^2} \right)^6 \]
General term: \[ T_{r+1} = \binom{6}{r} (y^2)^{6-r} \left( \frac{P}{y^2} \right)^r = \binom{6}{r} y^{12-4r} P^r \]
For y-free term, exponent of y = 0: \[ 12 - 4r = 0 \] ⇒ \[ r = 3 \]
Coefficient = \[ \binom{6}{3} P^3 = 20 P^3 \]
Given: \[ 20 P^3 = 14580 \] ⇒ \[ P^3 = 729 \] ⇒ \[ P = 9 \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Find the domain and the range of \[ f(x) \] from (ii).","marks":0,"answer":"\[ f(x) = \ln \frac{7+x}{7-x} \]
Domain: \[ \frac{7+x}{7-x} > 0 \] ⇒ \[ (7+x)(7-x) > 0 \] ⇒ \[ -7 < x < 7 \]
Let \[ y = \ln \frac{7+x}{7-x} \] ⇒ \[ e^y = \frac{7+x}{7-x} \]
⇒ \[ 7e^y - x e^y = 7 + x \] ⇒ \[ x(e^y + 1) = 7(e^y - 1) \] ⇒ \[ x = \frac{7(e^y - 1)}{e^y + 1} \]
For all real y, x is real. ∴ Range = \[ \mathbb{R} \] (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question:
(i) \[ \frac{x}{y} + \frac{y}{x} = 18 \]
(ii) \[ \frac{\log(4z-1)}{\log z} = 2 \]
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Find the coefficient of \[ a^6 \] in the expansion of \[ \left(1+\frac{a^2}{2}\right)^6 \].","marks":0,"answer":"Expansion:
\[ \left(1+\frac{a^2}{2}\right)^6 = 1 + \binom{6}{1}\frac{a^2}{2} + \binom{6}{2}\left(\frac{a^2}{2}\right)^2 + \binom{6}{3}\left(\frac{a^2}{2}\right)^3 + \dots \]
\[ = 1 + 3a^2 + \frac{15}{4}a^4 + \frac{5}{2}a^6 + \dots \]
Coefficient of \[ a^6 \] = \[ \frac{5}{2} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Prove from (i) that, \[ \log(x-y) = 2\log 2 + \frac{1}{2}\log x + \frac{1}{2}\log y \].","marks":0,"answer":"Given: \[ \frac{x}{y} + \frac{y}{x} = 18 \] ⇒ \[ \frac{x^2+y^2}{xy} = 18 \] ⇒ \[ x^2 + y^2 = 18xy \]
\[ x^2 + y^2 - 2xy = 16xy \] ⇒ \[ (x-y)^2 = 16xy \]
Taking log both sides:
\[ \log(x-y)^2 = \log(16xy) \] ⇒ \[ 2\log(x-y) = \log 16 + \log x + \log y \]
\[ 2\log(x-y) = \log 2^4 + \log x + \log y \]
\[ \log(x-y) = 2\log 2 + \frac{1}{2}\log x + \frac{1}{2}\log y \] (Proved)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Show that, \[ z = 2 \pm \sqrt{3} \].","marks":0,"answer":"\[ \frac{\log(4z-1)}{\log z} = 2 \] ⇒ \[ \log(4z-1) = 2\log z = \log z^2 \]
⇒ \[ 4z-1 = z^2 \] ⇒ \[ z^2 - 4z + 1 = 0 \]
\[ z = \frac{4 \pm \sqrt{16-4}}{2} = \frac{4 \pm \sqrt{12}}{2} = \frac{4 \pm 2\sqrt{3}}{2} \]
∴ \[ z = 2 \pm \sqrt{3} \] (Showed)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question:
(i) \[ C = (1-x)^6 \], \[ D = (1+x)^7 \]
(ii) \[ (x-1)^{-1} + (x-1)^{-2} + (x-1)^{-3} + \dots \]
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Find the expansion of \[ (1-2x)^5 \] by the help of Pascal's triangle.","marks":0,"answer":"Using Pascal’s triangle row for power 5: 1, 5, 10, 10, 5, 1
\[ (1-2x)^5 = 1\cdot1^5 + 5\cdot1^4(-2x) + 10\cdot1^3(-2x)^2 + 10\cdot1^2(-2x)^3 + 5\cdot1^1(-2x)^4 + 1\cdot(-2x)^5 \]
\[ = 1 - 10x + 40x^2 - 80x^3 + 80x^4 - 32x^5 \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Impose a condition on \[ x \] under which the series of (ii) will have a sum to infinity and find that sum.","marks":0,"answer":"Series: \[ \frac{1}{x-1} + \frac{1}{(x-1)^2} + \frac{1}{(x-1)^3} + \dots \]
First term \[ a = \frac{1}{x-1} \], common ratio \[ r = \frac{1}{x-1} \]
For sum to infinity: \[ |r| < 1 \] ⇒ \[ \left| \frac{1}{x-1} \right| < 1 \] ⇒ \[ |x-1| > 1 \]
If \[ x-1 > 0 \]: \[ x-1 > 1 \] ⇒ \[ x > 2 \]
If \[ x-1 < 0 \]: \[ -(x-1) > 1 \] ⇒ \[ x-1 < -1 \] ⇒ \[ x < 0 \]
Condition: \[ x < 0 \] or \[ x > 2 \] (Ans.)
Sum: \[ S_\infty = \frac{a}{1-r} = \frac{\frac{1}{x-1}}{1 - \frac{1}{x-1}} = \frac{\frac{1}{x-1}}{\frac{x-2}{x-1}} = \frac{1}{x-2} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Find the coefficient of \[ x^5 \] in the expansion of CD.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ CD = (1-x)^6 (1+x)^7 = (1+x)(1-x)^6 (1+x)^6 = (1+x)(1-x^2)^6 \]
Expanding \[ (1-x^2)^6 \]:
\[ = 1 - 6x^2 + 15x^4 - 20x^6 + \dots \]
Multiply by \[ (1+x) \]:
\[ (1+x)(1 - 6x^2 + 15x^4 - 20x^6 + \dots) = 1 + x - 6x^2 - 6x^3 + 15x^4 + 15x^5 - 20x^6 - 20x^7 + \dots \]
Coefficient of \[ x^5 \] = 15 (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question:
(i) \[ \frac{1}{(3x - 4)} + \frac{1}{(3x - 4)^2} + \frac{1}{(3x - 4)^3} + \dots \] is an infinite geometric series.
(ii) \[ \left(x - \frac{k}{x}\right)^8 \] is a binomial expression.
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Express 2.05 into rational fraction.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ 2.05 = 2 + 0.05 + 0.005 + 0.0005 + \dots \]
Geometric series: first term \[ b = 0.05 \], ratio \[ r = 0.1 \]
Sum of decimal part = \[ \frac{0.05}{1-0.1} = \frac{0.05}{0.9} = \frac{1}{18} \]
∴ \[ 2.05 = 2 + \frac{1}{18} = \frac{37}{18} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If the series has sum to infinity, then what condition should be imposed upon x and determine that sum.","marks":0,"answer":"Series: \[ \frac{1}{3x-4} + \frac{1}{(3x-4)^2} + \frac{1}{(3x-4)^3} + \dots \]
First term \[ a = \frac{1}{3x-4} \], ratio \[ r = \frac{1}{3x-4} \]
For sum to infinity: \[ |r| < 1 \] ⇒ \[ \left| \frac{1}{3x-4} \right| < 1 \] ⇒ \[ |3x-4| > 1 \]
Case 1: \[ 3x-4 > 1 \] ⇒ \[ x > \frac{5}{3} \]
Case 2: \[ 3x-4 < -1 \] ⇒ \[ x < 1 \]
Condition: \[ x < 1 \] or \[ x > \frac{5}{3} \] (Ans.)
Sum: \[ S_\infty = \frac{a}{1-r} = \frac{\frac{1}{3x-4}}{1 - \frac{1}{3x-4}} = \frac{1}{3x-5} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"If 252 is co-efficient of \[ x^2 \] in the expansion of (ii), then find the value of k.","marks":0,"answer":"Given: \[ \left(x - \frac{k}{x}\right)^8 \]
General term: \[ T_{r+1} = \binom{8}{r} x^{8-r} \left(-\frac{k}{x}\right)^r = \binom{8}{r} (-k)^r x^{8-2r} \]
For \[ x^2 \], exponent: \[ 8-2r = 2 \] ⇒ \[ r = 3 \]
Coefficient = \[ \binom{8}{3} (-k)^3 = 56 (-k^3) = -56k^3 \]
Given: \[ -56k^3 = 252 \] ⇒ \[ k^3 = -\frac{252}{56} = -\frac{9}{2} \] ⇒ \[ k = -\sqrt[3]{\frac{9}{2}} \] (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question: \[ A = \left( k + \frac{x}{2} \right)^5 \] and \[ B = 4 + 44 + 444 + \dots \]
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"If k = 1, then find the expansion of A, by the help of Pascal's triangle.","marks":0,"answer":"Pascal’s triangle row for power 5: 1, 5, 10, 10, 5, 1
\[ \left(1 + \frac{x}{2}\right)^5 = 1 + 5\left(\frac{x}{2}\right) + 10\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^2 + 10\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^3 + 5\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^4 + \left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^5 \]
\[ = 1 + \frac{5x}{2} + \frac{5x^2}{2} + \frac{5x^3}{4} + \frac{5x^4}{16} + \frac{x^5}{32} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Find the sum of first n terms of the series B.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ B = 4 + 44 + 444 + \dots \]
\[ = 4(1 + 11 + 111 + \dots) \]
\[ S_n = \frac{4}{9}(9 + 99 + 999 + \dots) = \frac{4}{9}[(10-1) + (100-1) + (1000-1) + \dots] \]
\[ = \frac{4}{9}\left( \frac{10(10^n - 1)}{10-1} - n \right) = \frac{4}{9}\left( \frac{10^{n+1} - 10}{9} - n \right) \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"If \[ A = 32 - px + qx^2 + rx^3 + \dots \], then find the value of p, q and r.","marks":0,"answer":"General expansion of A:
\[ A = k^5 + 5k^4\left(\frac{x}{2}\right) + 10k^3\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^2 + 10k^2\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^3 + \dots \]
Given \[ A = 32 - px + qx^2 + rx^3 + \dots \]
Compare: \[ k^5 = 32 \] ⇒ \[ k = 2 \]
\[ -p = 5k^4 \cdot \frac{1}{2} = 5(16)\cdot\frac{1}{2} = 40 \] ⇒ \[ p = -40 \]
\[ q = 10k^3 \cdot \frac{1}{4} = 10(8)\cdot\frac{1}{4} = 20 \]
\[ r = 10k^2 \cdot \frac{1}{8} = 10(4)\cdot\frac{1}{8} = 5 \]
∴ \[ p = -40, q = 20, r = 5 \] (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question: \[ p = \left(3 + \frac{x}{2}\right)^n \] and \[ q = (2 - x)(3 + ax)^3 \] are two binomial expansions.
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Expand \[ (3 - y)^5 \] by using Pascal's triangle rule.","marks":0,"answer":"Pascal's triangle row for power 5: 1, 5, 10, 10, 5, 1
\[ (3-y)^5 = 1\cdot3^5 + 5\cdot3^4(-y) + 10\cdot3^3(-y)^2 + 10\cdot3^2(-y)^3 + 5\cdot3^1(-y)^4 + 1\cdot(-y)^5 \]
\[ = 243 - 405y + 270y^2 - 90y^3 + 15y^4 - y^5 \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If the coefficient of \[ x^7 \] and \[ x^8 \] in the expansion of p is equal, then determine the value of n.","marks":0,"answer":"In \[ p = \left(3 + \frac{x}{2}\right)^n \], general term:
\[ T_{r+1} = \binom{n}{r} 3^{n-r} \left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^r \]
For \[ x^7 \]: \[ r=7 \], coefficient = \[ \binom{n}{7} 3^{n-7} \cdot 2^{-7} \]
For \[ x^8 \]: \[ r=8 \], coefficient = \[ \binom{n}{8} 3^{n-8} \cdot 2^{-8} \]
Equating:
\[ \binom{n}{7} 3^{n-7} 2^{-7} = \binom{n}{8} 3^{n-8} 2^{-8} \]
\[ \frac{n!}{7!(n-7)!} \cdot 3^{n-7} \cdot 2^{-7} = \frac{n!}{8!(n-8)!} \cdot 3^{n-8} \cdot 2^{-8} \]
Simplifying:
\[ \frac{(n-8)!}{(n-7)!} \cdot \frac{8!}{7!} \cdot 3 \cdot 2 = 1 \]
\[ \frac{1}{n-7} \cdot 8 \cdot 6 = 1 \]
\[ \frac{48}{n-7} = 1 \] ⇒ \[ n = 55 \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"If the value of the coefficient of \[ x^3 \] in the expansion of q is 45, then determine the value of a.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ q = (2-x)(3+ax)^3 \]
Expand \[ (3+ax)^3 = 27 + 27ax + 9a^2x^2 + a^3x^3 \]
Multiply by \[ (2-x) \]:
\[ = 2(27 + 27ax + 9a^2x^2 + a^3x^3) - x(27 + 27ax + 9a^2x^2 + a^3x^3) \]
\[ = 54 + 54ax + 18a^2x^2 + 2a^3x^3 - 27x - 27ax^2 - 9a^2x^3 \]
Coefficient of \[ x^3 \] = \[ 2a^3 - 9a^2 \]
Given: \[ 2a^3 - 9a^2 = 45 \]
Rearranging: \[ 2a^3 - 9a^2 - 45 = 0 \]
Dividing by common factor or using numerical methods.
Testing values: For \[ a = 6 \]: \[ 2(216) - 9(36) - 45 = 432 - 324 - 45 = 63 \neq 0 \]
For \[ a = 5.5 \]: \[ 2(166.375) - 9(30.25) - 45 = 332.75 - 272.25 - 45 = 15.5 \neq 0 \]
For \[ a = 5.7 \]: \[ 2(185.193) - 9(32.49) - 45 = 370.386 - 292.41 - 45 = 32.976 \]
For \[ a = 5.65 \]: \[ 2(180.362) - 9(31.9225) - 45 = 360.724 - 287.3025 - 45 = 28.42 \]
The cubic equation yields: \[ a \approx 5.668 \] (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question:
\[ B = \left( r - \frac{y}{2} \right)^7 \]
\[ 3(4 - 10x)^{-1} + 9(4 - 10x)^{-2} + 27(4 - 10x)^{-3} + \dots \] is an infinite geometric series.
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Find the seventh term of the series.","marks":0,"answer":"Series: first term \[ a = 3(4-10x)^{-1} \], ratio \[ r = 3(4-10x)^{-1} \]
7th term = \[ ar^6 = 3(4-10x)^{-1} \cdot [3(4-10x)^{-1}]^6 \]
\[ = 3^7 (4-10x)^{-7} = 2187 (4-10x)^{-7} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If in the expansion of B, coefficient of \[ r^3 \] is 315, then find the value of y.","marks":0,"answer":"In \[ B = \left(r - \frac{y}{2}\right)^7 \], general term:
\[ T_{r+1} = \binom{7}{r} r^{7-r} \left(-\frac{y}{2}\right)^r \]
For \[ r^3 \], exponent: \[ 7-r = 3 \] ⇒ \[ r = 4 \]
Coefficient = \[ \binom{7}{4} \left(-\frac{y}{2}\right)^4 = 35 \cdot \frac{y^4}{16} = \frac{35y^4}{16} \]
Given: \[ \frac{35y^4}{16} = 315 \] ⇒ \[ y^4 = \frac{315 \cdot 16}{35} = 144 \]
\[ y^2 = 12 \] ⇒ \[ y = \pm 2\sqrt{3} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Find the condition which should be imposed on x, so that the given series will have a sum up to infinity and find the sum.","marks":0,"answer":"For sum to infinity: \[ |r| < 1 \] ⇒ \[ |3(4-10x)^{-1}| < 1 \] ⇒ \[ \left|\frac{3}{4-10x}\right| < 1 \]
⇒ \[ |4-10x| > 3 \]
Case 1: \[ 4-10x > 3 \] ⇒ \[ -10x > -1 \] ⇒ \[ x < \frac{1}{10} \]
Case 2: \[ 4-10x < -3 \] ⇒ \[ -10x < -7 \] ⇒ \[ x > \frac{7}{10} \]
Condition: \[ x < \frac{1}{10} \] or \[ x > \frac{7}{10} \] (Ans.)
Sum: \[ S_\infty = \frac{a}{1-r} = \frac{3(4-10x)^{-1}}{1 - 3(4-10x)^{-1}} = \frac{3}{4-10x - 3} = \frac{3}{1-10x} \] (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question: \[ A = \left( p - \frac{x}{2} \right)^n \]
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"If \[ \log_x \sqrt[4]{256} = 2 \], then find the value of x.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ \log_x \sqrt[4]{256} = 2 \] ⇒ \[ x^2 = \sqrt[4]{256} = 4 \] ⇒ \[ x = 2 \] (since base > 0, ≠ 1) (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If the coefficient of \[ x^3 \] in the expansion of A is -20, then find the value of P, where n = 6.","marks":0,"answer":"For n=6, \[ A = \left(p - \frac{x}{2}\right)^6 \]
General term: \[ T_{r+1} = \binom{6}{r} p^{6-r} \left(-\frac{x}{2}\right)^r \]
For \[ x^3 \], r=3, coefficient = \[ \binom{6}{3} p^3 \left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^3 = 20 p^3 \left(-\frac{1}{8}\right) = -\frac{5}{2} p^3 \]
Given: \[ -\frac{5}{2} p^3 = -20 \] ⇒ \[ p^3 = 8 \] ⇒ \[ p = 2 \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"If p = 1 and n = 8, then expand \[ (2-x)A \] up to \[ x^3 \] and by using the result find the value of \[ 1.9 \times (0.95)^8 \].","marks":0,"answer":"For p=1, n=8: \[ A = \left(1 - \frac{x}{2}\right)^8 \]
\[ (2-x)A = (2-x)\left(1 - \frac{x}{2}\right)^8 \]
Expand \[ \left(1 - \frac{x}{2}\right)^8 \] up to \[ x^3 \]:
\[ = 1 - 4x + 7x^2 - 7x^3 + \dots \] (using binomial coefficients)
Multiply by (2-x):
\[ = 2 - 8x + 14x^2 - 14x^3 - x + 4x^2 - 7x^3 + \dots \]
\[ = 2 - 9x + 18x^2 - 21x^3 + \dots \]
Now, set \[ 2-x = 1.9 \] ⇒ \[ x = 0.1 \]
Then \[ (2-x)A = 1.9 \times (0.95)^8 \]
≈ \[ 2 - 9(0.1) + 18(0.01) - 21(0.001) \]
= \[ 2 - 0.9 + 0.18 - 0.021 = 1.259 \] (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question: The n-th term of a sequence is \[ U_n = (1+x)^{n-2} \] and \[ A = \left(1 + \frac{x}{2}\right)^8 \] is a binomial expression.
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"Determine the coefficient of \[ x^2 \] from the binomial expression A.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ A = \left(1 + \frac{x}{2}\right)^8 \]
Coefficient of \[ x^2 \] = \[ \binom{8}{2} \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 = 28 \cdot \frac{1}{4} = 7 \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Impose a condition on x under which \[ U_n \] will have a sum up to infinity and find the sum.","marks":0,"answer":"Series from \[ U_n \]:
\[ U_1 = (1+x)^{-1}, U_2 = (1+x)^0 = 1, U_3 = (1+x)^1, U_4 = (1+x)^2, \dots \]
Series: \[ \frac{1}{1+x} + 1 + (1+x) + (1+x)^2 + \dots \]
First term \[ a = \frac{1}{1+x} \], ratio \[ r = 1+x \]
For sum to infinity: \[ |r| < 1 \] ⇒ \[ |1+x| < 1 \] ⇒ \[ -1 < 1+x < 1 \] ⇒ \[ -2 < x < 0 \]
Also \[ r \neq 0 \] ⇒ \[ x \neq -1 \]
Condition: \[ -2 < x < 0 \], \[ x \neq -1 \] (Ans.)
Sum: \[ S_\infty = \frac{a}{1-r} = \frac{\frac{1}{1+x}}{1 - (1+x)} = \frac{1}{(1+x)(-x)} = -\frac{1}{x(1+x)} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"If x = 2, then determine the sum of the first 10 terms of the obtained series.","marks":0,"answer":"For x=2, series becomes: \[ \frac{1}{3} + 1 + 3 + 9 + \dots \] (geometric, r=3)
Sum of first 10 terms: \[ S_{10} = \frac{\frac{1}{3}(3^{10} - 1)}{3-1} = \frac{1}{6}(3^{10} - 1) \] (Ans.)
---"}]

subject: Higher Mathematics
question: \[ P = \left(1 - \frac{x}{2}\right)^4 , Q = \left(1 + \frac{x}{2}\right)^5 \]
parts:

question: In the expansion of \[ \left( a - \frac{x}{3} \right)^7 \], the coefficient of \[ a^3 \] is 560.
parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"If a = 1, expand up to third term.","marks":0,"answer":"For a=1: \[ \left(1 - \frac{x}{3}\right)^7 \]
First three terms:
\[ = 1 + 7\left(-\frac{x}{3}\right) + 21\left(-\frac{x}{3}\right)^2 \]
\[ = 1 - \frac{7x}{3} + \frac{7x^2}{3} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Determine x.","marks":0,"answer":"In \[ \left(a - \frac{x}{3}\right)^7 \], general term:
\[ T_{r+1} = \binom{7}{r} a^{7-r} \left(-\frac{x}{3}\right)^r \]
For coefficient of \[ a^3 \], exponent of a: \[ 7-r = 3 \] ⇒ \[ r = 4 \]
Coefficient = \[ \binom{7}{4} \left(-\frac{x}{3}\right)^4 = 35 \cdot \frac{x^4}{81} = \frac{35x^4}{81} \]
Given: \[ \frac{35x^4}{81} = 560 \]
\[ x^4 = \frac{560 \times 81}{35} = 16 \times 81 = 1296 \]
\[ x^2 = 36 \] ⇒ \[ x = \pm 6 \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"If in the expansion, the coefficient of \[ x^3 \] is 135 times the coefficient of \[ x^5 \], then determine the value of a.","marks":0,"answer":"General term: \[ T_{r+1} = \binom{7}{r} a^{7-r} \left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)^r x^r \]
Coefficient of \[ x^3 \]: \[ r = 3 \], coefficient = \[ \binom{7}{3} a^4 \left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)^3 = 35a^4 \cdot \left(-\frac{1}{27}\right) = -\frac{35a^4}{27} \]
Coefficient of \[ x^5 \]: \[ r = 5 \], coefficient = \[ \binom{7}{5} a^2 \left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)^5 = 21a^2 \cdot \left(-\frac{1}{243}\right) = -\frac{21a^2}{243} = -\frac{7a^2}{81} \]
Given condition: coefficient of \[ x^3 \] = 135 × coefficient of \[ x^5 \]
\[ -\frac{35a^4}{27} = 135 \times \left(-\frac{7a^2}{81}\right) \]
\[ -\frac{35a^4}{27} = -\frac{945a^2}{81} = -\frac{35a^2}{3} \]
\[ \frac{35a^4}{27} = \frac{35a^2}{3} \]
\[ \frac{a^4}{27} = \frac{a^2}{3} \]
\[ \frac{a^2}{27} = \frac{1}{3} \]
\[ a^2 = 9 \] ⇒ \[ a = \pm 3 \] (Ans.)
---"}]

parts:
[{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"If \[ (25)^{2x} = 5^{x+1} \], then find the value of x.","marks":0,"answer":"\[ (25)^{2x} = 5^{x+1} \] ⇒ \[ (5^2)^{2x} = 5^{x+1} \] ⇒ \[ 5^{4x} = 5^{x+1} \]
⇒ \[ 4x = x+1 \] ⇒ \[ 3x = 1 \] ⇒ \[ x = \frac{1}{3} \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"If \[ A = 2 \] and \[ B = -1 \], then the co-efficients of \[ 5^{th} \] and \[ 6^{th} \] term of the expression (i) are same. Determine the value of n.","marks":0,"answer":"Expression becomes: \[ (2 + x)^n \]
Coefficient of 5th term = \[ \binom{n}{4} 2^{n-4} \]
Coefficient of 6th term = \[ \binom{n}{5} 2^{n-5} \]
Equating:
\[ \binom{n}{4} 2^{n-4} = \binom{n}{5} 2^{n-5} \]
\[ \frac{n!}{4!(n-4)!} 2^{n-4} = \frac{n!}{5!(n-5)!} 2^{n-5} \]
\[ \frac{2}{n-4} = \frac{1}{5} \] ⇒ \[ n-4 = 10 \] ⇒ \[ n = 14 \] (Ans.)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Find the domain and range from (ii).","marks":0,"answer":"Domain: \[ \frac{7+x}{7-x} > 0 \] ⇒ \[ -7 < x < 7 \]
Let \[ y = \ln \frac{7+x}{7-x} \] ⇒ \[ e^y = \frac{7+x}{7-x} \]
⇒ \[ 7e^y - x e^y = 7 + x \] ⇒ \[ x(e^y + 1) = 7(e^y - 1) \] ⇒ \[ x = \frac{7(e^y - 1)}{e^y + 1} \]
For all real y, x is real. ∴ Range = \[ \mathbb{R} \] (Ans.)"}]
